summary.text: Tim Kearney is a Democratic state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 26 in eastern Delaware County since 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He is an architect and a former mayor of Swarthmore.

paragraphs.text: Tim Kearney is the only architect in the Pennsylvania Senate, according to his official biography, and the son of a teacher.
He served 11 years on the Swarthmore Planning Commission, seven of them as chair, and was then elected to two terms as mayor, for 16 years of service to the borough in all.

For the 2025-2026 session, Kearney is Democratic chair of the Institutional Sustainability and Innovation Committee and serves on the Appropriations, Education, Local Government, and Transportation committees.
His biography says his priorities include public education, safe and healthy neighborhoods, public health systems, clean energy and environmental stewardship, and transportation funding.
He maintains district offices in Media and Upper Darby.
